children: CACI Intl. said it was awarded a contract to work with U.S. Central Command to enhance planning, analysis, information integration, and mission execution.
The Command's area of responsibility covers the Middle East, Central Asia, and parts of South Asia and Northeast Africa.
The contract period is for one year, and includes four option periods. The contract has a ceiling of $1.5 billion, and CACI said it expects to book $1.2 billion of the total awarded value.
The national security company said the award builds on its experience with irregular warfare missions across geographic and functional combatant commands.
